description: The same chain as compose-0018 with its middle link left out of the selection: agent-v3 supersedes agent-v2, agent-v2 supersedes agent-v1, and only agent-v1 and agent-v3 are selected. agent-v2 is in the graph but not in the set Step 1 closed (nothing requires it), so it hides nothing, and agent-v3 does not supersede agent-v1 itself: hiding does not pass through an item outside that set, and supersedes is not made transitive. hidden[] is empty and both selected items survive.
